query:
-- 1. Overall race counts by status
SELECT status, COUNT(*) as count FROM house_races GROUP BY status ORDER BY status;

-- 2. Tonight's NE and WV races specifically
SELECT state, district, race_type, status, called_candidate, called_party, last_updated
FROM house_races
WHERE state IN ('NE', 'WV')
ORDER BY state, district;

-- 3. Senate races status
SELECT state, status, called_candidate, called_party, last_updated
FROM senate_races
WHERE year = 2026
ORDER BY state;

-- 4. Most recent AP update timestamp
SELECT MAX(last_updated) as last_ap_update FROM house_races;
